description: This source file defines an immutable class JsonObjectMerger that implements a BiFunction to recursively merge two JsonObject instances into one, with conflict resolution favoring the first object.

classes.name: JsonObjectMerger
classes.description: A package-private, immutable class that merges two JsonObjects into one, recursively handling nested objects and arrays, with conflicts resolved in favor of the first object.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Overrides the BiFunction's apply method to merge two JsonObjects into one.

methods.name: mergeJsonObjects
methods.description: Recursively merges two JsonObjects into one, combining fields and handling nested objects and arrays.

methods.name: mergeJsonValues
methods.description: Merges two JsonValues, delegating to object or array merge methods if applicable.

methods.name: areJsonObjects
methods.description: Checks if both JsonValues are JsonObjects.

methods.name: areJsonArrays
methods.description: Checks if both JsonValues are JsonArrays.

methods.name: mergeJsonArrays
methods.description: Merges two JsonArrays element-wise, combining values and appending remaining elements from the longer array.

methods.name: getOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves an element at a specific index from a JsonArray, throwing an exception if out of bounds.
